PLAN "12-Week Strength & Hypertrophy Programme (2026-06-01 Start)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and improve body composition"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
